means: For every scored T-spin in the corpus (a T with an engine spin credit that cleared lines, inside the verified prefix, passing the reconstruction check), whether it was a DONATION: a piece laid over empty cells so that it overhangs them inside the rows the T-spin clears, so the clear opens those cells from the top again (基本的なドネイト, 「TSDで消える2列だけを埋める」, as yachi states it). Every hit is followed to the first later piece that enters its hole's column, to see whether it is the Tetris harddrop's Donation page draws next.
not_eligible_because: simulator output: which board a T went into is read off the vendored Triangle engine's boards, and nothing on the corpus side has a second implementation of it. No claim id, no badge, no figure in a report.
caveat: garbage is read as FILLED, and its hole columns are the engine's seeded-RNG columns, which disagree with the recorded ones (oracle-source.ts): a hole under a donation can be a garbage row's hole, so a hit's hole is the board the oracle offered, and a hit with garbage in its box is named in garbage_in_window. Most named donations are hits too; the qualify rule gives such a T to the page that names it (other_page). The payoff is harddrop's next step, not shiwehi.com's. Counts only, always N / M with the denominator.
rules: opportunity: a full TSD (2 lines) at a 0-based lock index <= the verified index, whose board-before plus its cells makes exactly the rows the engine recorded clearing (the reconstruction check, counted exactly as opener-facts.json donation.check counts it)

match (no window): a column DONATES when, at its topmost cell that is empty, outside the cleared rows and directly under a cleared-row cell, (1) every filled cell of the column above it lies in the cleared rows, (2) each is the T or a cell of a complete piece (all four cells on the board before the T, never garbage), and (3) the cell directly above it is not the T (a hole under the T's nub alone is a plain T-spin), and (4) when the piece directly above it locked, the cell under that piece's lowest cell in the column was already empty (the hole came first: garbage rising under a piece later covered nothing); the lock is a hit when any column donates; cover = cleared when every covering piece lies inside the cleared rows, else kept

the hit's own column (its payoff well and its box): the donating column nearest to the T's columns, then the leftmost; the box runs from the row over the cleared rows to the row under that hole, over the T and that column

payoff: the hole's top cell carried through every clear and garbage insertion, each step verified against the engine's next board, to the first later lock with a cell in its column; fired iff that lock is inside the verified prefix, has a cell at or below the carried cell, is an I and cleared 4 lines (otherwise past_verified, well_covered, well_filled_not_i, i_in_well_not_quad, rowmap_unverified, slot_off_board or round_ended); well_depth = the empty cells from that hole down, garbage filled

controls: the same rule at the profile's other scored spins; ablations allow_t_nub (rule 3 dropped), allow_fragment (rule 2 dropped), no_reopen (rule 1 dropped) and allow_late_hole (rule 4 dropped) at the opportunity; orientation_baseline = opportunities whose T stands up
window_rule: 0-based lock index <= 21 is in_opener (emit-opener-facts.ts's convention; emit-attack-facts.ts counts from 1)

rules: other_page: another technique page's window (stsd, stmbcave, imperialcross, doubledagger, btcannon, cutcopy, shachikutrain, parapet, kaidan, dtcannon; any variant, either hand) fires at the same T, so the T is that page's

opener_route: the round is a case of an opener route page (stray-cannon, honey-cup, mountainous2, stickspin, gamushiro, sdpcspin) that matched a bag-2 board, and the T locks within 14 locks after that match, so the T is the route's own continuation
qualifies iff neither applies; the donation happened at every hit either way
